```{r}
# Read LUAD
luad <- read.delim("xCell/LUAD_RNAseq_xCell_Tumor.cct", header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# Read HNSCC

colnames(hnscc_df) <- hnscc$idx

hnscc_df$TumorType <- "HNSCC"
rownames(hnscc_df) <- NULL

# Read UCEC
```

```{r}
library(ggpubr)

# Define mapping: plot label → column name
celltype_map <- c(
  "CD8+ T" = "T cell CD8+",
  "CD4+ T" = "T cell CD4+ (non-regulatory)",
  "B cell" = "B cell",
  "NK cell" = "NK cell",
  "Macrophage M1" = "Macrophage M1",
  "Macrophage M2" = "Macrophage M2",
  "Neutrophils" = "Neutrophil",
  "Dendritic cell" = "Myeloid dendritic cell",
  "Fibroblast" = "Cancer associated fibroblast",
  "Endothelial cells" = "Endothelial cell"
)

# Recompute filtered subset (do not alter `merged`)
subset_9p <- merged %>%
  mutate(
    CNV_9p_status = case_when(
      Arm_9p < -0.2 ~ "Loss",
      Arm_9p >= -0.2 & Arm_9p <= 0.2 ~ "Neutral",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(CNV_9p_status %in% c("Loss", "Neutral"))

# Generate one plot per cell type
plots <- lapply(names(celltype_map), function(label) {
  colname <- celltype_map[[label]]
  
  ggplot(subset_9p, aes_string(x = "CNV_9p_status", y = paste0("`", colname, "`"), fill = "CNV_9p_status")) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(label, " Scores by 9p CNV Status (Loss vs Neutral)"),
      x = "9p CNV Status",
      y = paste0("xCell ", label, " Score")
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Loss" = "#4575b4", "Neutral" = "grey70")) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", alternative = "less") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
})

# Optional: display one (e.g., plots[[1]]) or arrange all with patchwork or cowplot
print(plots[[3]])

# Save all cell type boxplots to one multi-page PDF
pdf("xCell_9pLoss_LUAD.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)  # adjust size as needed
for (p in plots) {
  print(p)
}
dev.off()
```

## PLot others
```{r}
plot_cnv_status <- function(tumor, arm, direction = c("Gain", "Loss"), file_name) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  # Extract data for given tumor
  subset_df <- merged %>%
    filter(TumorType == tumor)

  # Create CNV_Status column based on direction
  if (direction == "Gain") {
    subset_df <- subset_df %>%
      mutate(
        CNV_Status = case_when(
          !!sym(arm) > 0.3 ~ "Gain",
          abs(!!sym(arm)) <= 0.3 ~ "Neutral",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )
  } else if (direction == "Loss") {
    subset_df <- subset_df %>%
      mutate(
        CNV_Status = case_when(
          !!sym(arm) < -0.3 ~ "Loss",
          abs(!!sym(arm)) <= 0.3 ~ "Neutral",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      )
  }

  # Filter to valid comparisons
  subset_df <- subset_df %>%
    filter(CNV_Status %in% c(direction, "Neutral"))

  if (nrow(subset_df) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for", tumor, arm, direction))
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Make plots
  plots <- lapply(names(celltype_map), function(label) {
    colname <- celltype_map[[label]]
    ggplot(subset_df, aes_string(x = "CNV_Status", y = paste0("`", colname, "`"), fill = "CNV_Status")) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(label, " Scores by ", arm, " ", direction, " in ", tumor),
        x = paste(arm, "CNV Status"),
        y = paste0("xCell ", label, " Score")
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Gain" = "#EA6A6A", "Loss" = "#4575b4", "Neutral" = "grey70")) +
      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", method.args = list(alternative = "less"), label = "p.format") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
  })

  # Save PDF
  pdf(file_name, width = 7, height = 5)
  for (p in plots) print(p)
  dev.off()
}
```

```{r}
# HNSC (not HNSCC — use exact TumorType label in your merged$TumorType)
```

Heatmaps
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)

# ---- Subset for relevant columns ----
heatmap_df <- merged %>%
  select(TumorType, starts_with("Arm_"), `T cell CD8+`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Arm_"), names_to = "ChromArm", values_to = "CNV_Value") %>%
  mutate(
    CNV_Status = case_when(
      CNV_Value > 0.3  ~ "Gain",
      CNV_Value < -0.3 ~ "Loss",
      TRUE             ~ "Neutral"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(CNV_Status %in% c("Gain", "Loss", "Neutral"))

# ---- Wilcoxon test: Gain vs Neutral & Loss vs Neutral ----
results <- heatmap_df %>%
  group_by(TumorType, ChromArm, CNV_Status) %>%
  summarise(score = list(`T cell CD8+`), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = CNV_Status, values_from = score) %>%
  mutate(
    # Gain vs Neutral
    gain_p = map2_dbl(Gain, Neutral, ~ if (!is.null(.x) && !is.null(.y) && length(.x) >= 5 && length(.y) >= 5)
      wilcox.test(.x, .y)$p.value else NA),
    gain_dir = map2_dbl(Gain, Neutral, ~ if (!is.null(.x) && !is.null(.y)) median(.x, na.rm=TRUE) - median(.y, na.rm=TRUE) else 0),
    
    # Loss vs Neutral
    loss_p = map2_dbl(Loss, Neutral, ~ if (!is.null(.x) && !is.null(.y) && length(.x) >= 5 && length(.y) >= 5)
      wilcox.test(.x, .y)$p.value else NA),
    loss_dir = map2_dbl(Loss, Neutral, ~ if (!is.null(.x) && !is.null(.y)) median(.x, na.rm=TRUE) - median(.y, na.rm=TRUE) else 0),
    
    # Signed log10p
    gain_logp = -log10(gain_p) * sign(gain_dir),
    loss_logp = -log10(loss_p) * sign(loss_dir)
  )

# ---- Combine gain and loss into one long format ----
gain_mat <- results %>%
  select(TumorType, ChromArm, gain_logp) %>%
  rename(log10p = gain_logp) %>%
  mutate(Status = "Gain")

loss_mat <- results %>%
  select(TumorType, ChromArm, loss_logp) %>%
  rename(log10p = loss_logp) %>%
  mutate(Status = "Loss")

combined_df <- bind_rows(gain_mat, loss_mat) %>%
  unite(ArmStatus, ChromArm, Status) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ArmStatus, values_from = log10p) %>%
  column_to_rownames("TumorType")

# ---- Plot heatmap ----
pheatmap(as.matrix(combined_df),
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("purple", "white", "brown"))(100),
         breaks = seq(-5, 5, length.out = 101),
         main = "CD8+ T Cell Association with CNV (Signed -log10 p)")
```

```{r}
# 1. Subset LUAD tumor type and Arm == "p" and Chromosome == "9"
# We'll combine all immune cells' regression tables into one long data frame
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract LUAD results only (top-level name in regression_results list)
luad_results <- regression_results[["LUAD"]]

# Combine all immune cell regression tables into one
combined_df <- bind_rows(lapply(names(luad_results), function(cell) {
  df <- luad_results[[cell]]
  df$Immune_Cell <- cell
  return(df)
}))

# 2. Filter for 9p only (Chromosome 9, Arm p) and Focal_Level "Loss" or "None"
df_9p <- combined_df %>%
  filter(Chromosome == "9", Arm == "p") %>%
  filter(Focal_Level %in% c("Loss", "None")) %>%
  mutate(CNV_Status = ifelse(Focal_Level == "Loss", "9p_Loss", "Neutral"))

# Extract immune cell names for LUAD 9p
immune_cells_present <- df_9p %>%
  pull(Immune_Cell) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

print(immune_cells_present)
```

```{r}
# If p-value column is available (e.g., P_Value), filter top 5
top5_cells <- df_9p %>%
  group_by(Immune_Cell) %>%
  summarise(min_p = min(P_val, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(min_p) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  pull(Immune_Cell)

# Filter df_9p to only those top 5
df_9p_top5 <- df_9p %>%
  filter(Immune_Cell %in% top5_cells)

# Plot 5 most significant 
ggplot(df_9p_top5, aes(x = CNV_Status, y = Coefficients, fill = CNV_Status)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Immune_Cell, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 5 Significant Immune Cells in LUAD (9p Loss vs. Neutral)",
    x = "CNV Status",
    y = "Immune Score (xCell Regression Coefficient)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
  facet_wrap(~ Immune_Cell, scales = "free_y") +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("9p_Loss" = "#FF9999", "Neutral" = "#9999FF")) +
  labs(
```

```{r}
plot_all_celltypes_by_cnv <- function(tumor, arm, direction = c("Gain", "Loss"), threshold = 0.3, filename_prefix = "xCell") {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  tumor_df <- merged %>%
    filter(TumorType == tumor)

  status_col <- paste0("CNV_", arm, "_status")
  cnv_col <- arm 

  tumor_df <- tumor_df %>%
    mutate(
      !!status_col := case_when(
        direction == "Gain" & !!sym(cnv_col) >  threshold ~ "Gain",
        direction == "Loss" & !!sym(cnv_col) < -threshold ~ "Loss",
        abs(!!sym(cnv_col)) <= threshold ~ "Neutral",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!!sym(status_col) %in% c(direction, "Neutral"))

  if (nrow(tumor_df) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for", tumor, arm, direction))
    return(NULL)
  }

  plots <- lapply(names(celltype_map), function(label) {
    colname <- celltype_map[[label]]
    ggplot(tumor_df, aes_string(x = status_col, y = paste0("`", colname, "`"), fill = status_col)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1, alpha = 0.6) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(label, " Scores by ", arm, " ", direction, " in ", tumor),
        x = paste(arm, "CNV Status"),
        y = paste0("xCell ", label, " Score")
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Gain" = "#EA6A6A", "Loss" = "#4575b4", "Neutral" = "grey70")) +
      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", method.args = list(alternative = "less")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
  })

  pdf(paste0(filename_prefix, "_", gsub("Arm_", "", arm), direction, "_", tumor, ".pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
  for (p in plots) print(p)
  dev.off()
}

# save as pdf
plot_all_celltypes_by_cnv("LUAD", "Arm1q", direction = "Gain")
plot_all_celltypes_by_cnv("HNSCC", "Arm9p", direction = "Loss")
plot_all_celltypes_by_cnv("UCEC", "Arm1q", direction = "Gain")
```

```{r}
plot_selected_cnv_celltypes <- function(tumor, arm, direction = c("Gain", "Loss"), selected_cells, threshold = 0.3, filename) {
  direction <- match.arg(direction)

  tumor_df <- merged %>%
    filter(TumorType == tumor)

  cnv_col <- paste0("Arm_", gsub("Arm_", "", arm))

  tumor_df <- tumor_df %>%
    mutate(
      !!status_col := case_when(
        direction == "Gain" & !!sym(cnv_col) >  threshold ~ "Gain",
        direction == "Loss" & !!sym(cnv_col) < -threshold ~ "Loss",
        abs(!!sym(cnv_col)) <= threshold ~ "Neutral",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!!sym(status_col) %in% c(direction, "Neutral"))

  if (nrow(tumor_df) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for", tumor, arm, direction))
    return(NULL)
  }

  plots <- lapply(names(selected_cells), function(label) {
    colname <- selected_cells[[label]]
    ggplot(tumor_df, aes_string(x = status_col, y = paste0("`", colname, "`"), fill = status_col)) +

      stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format", method.args = list(alternative = "less")) +
      theme_classic(base_size = 14)
  })

}
```

```{r}
# Create an empty data frame to store p-values
pval_table <- data.frame(
  CellType = character(),
  P_Value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through cell types and calculate Wilcoxon test p-values
for (cell_type in cell_types_to_plot) {
  if (cell_type %in% colnames(final_merged)) {
    # Subset data
    df <- final_merged[, c("CNV_1q_status", cell_type)]
    
    # Run Wilcoxon test only if both Gain and Non-Gain groups exist
    if (length(unique(df$CNV_1q_status)) == 2) {
      test <- wilcox.test(df[[cell_type]] ~ df$CNV_1q_status)
      pval_table <- rbind(pval_table, data.frame(
        CellType = cell_type,
        P_Value = test$p.value
      ))
    } else {
      message(paste("Skipping:", cell_type, "- only one CNV group present."))
    }
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping:", cell_type, "not found in dataset."))
  }
}

# Print table
print(pval_table)

# Optional: Sort by p-value
pval_table <- pval_table[order(pval_table$P_Value), ]
print(pval_table)
```
